text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
On her day off, Nozomi invites {0}
to spend the day together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}はオフのノゾミに誘われて、
一緒に散歩に出かけた。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since I had a day off!
I can finally let loose.
text_block_list.orig_text:
久々のオフだー！
やっと羽が伸ばせるよ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
So let's go all out today, {0}!
I'm sure we'll have an awesome time together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日はもう、めいっぱい遊ぼうね！
{0}くんと一緒なら、
絶対最高のオフになるから！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but let's not get too carried away.
If I get recognized by any fans,
that'll be it for my day off.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
でも、
あんまりはしゃぎすぎないようにしないと。
ファンのみんなに気づかれたら、
お休みどころじゃなくなっちゃうもんね。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's the matter, {0}?
Is there something over ther—
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
{0}くん、どうかした？
あっちになにか──

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
U-urgh! Where's this light coming from?!
I-it's so bright... Eeeeeek!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっ、
なに、
この光！？
ま、
まぶしい……
きゃあああ！！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
{0}!
Over here! Hurry!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、{0}くん！
こっちこっちー！　
いそいでー！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for calling you out of the blue!
One of my work plans just got canceled.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんね、
急に呼び出しちゃって！
お仕事が急にひとつ無くなっちゃって……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
I had some free time available,
so I wanted to do something fun before my next gig.
That's why I asked you to come!
text_block_list.orig_text:
せっかく時間が出来たんだから。
次の仕事までの間、
楽しいことしたいじゃない？
だから、
{0}くんに来てもらったの！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
We don't have much time,
but let's enjoy it as much as we can!
Where would you like to go?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんまり時間はないけど、
できるだけたくさん遊ぼうよ！
どこにいこっか？

text_block_list.name: Passerby 1
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Hey, look!
On the big screen... It's Nozomi!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
おい見ろよ！
あそこの街頭ディスプレイ、
のぞみんが出てるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What is it? Maybe the music show we just recorded?
Or the trailer for my movie?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
なんだろ？　
この間収録した歌番組かな？
それとも映画のＣＭかな？

text_block_list.name: Presenter
text_block_list.text:
\"Popular idol Nozomi Sakurai's love interest revealed?!\"
That's the headline for today's issue
of the...
text_block_list.orig_text:
「人気アイドル、
桜井望ちゃんに恋人発覚か！？」
今日発売の週刊誌に、
スクープ記事が。
掲載されていますが……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
The nerve of them! They're airing rumors about my love life!
Eww, yuck!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この番組……
私の恋愛ゴシップ流してる！？
やだな～
もう！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
It's all a bunch of nonsense, {0}!
That's just me talking with one of my co-stars on set.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん、こんなのデタラメだからねっ！
撮影現場で、共演者と話してただけなの。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
The photo makes it look like it's only the two of us,
but the whole crew was there.
They'll have to issue a retraction soon enough.
text_block_list.orig_text:
写真だと、
二人だけに見えるけど、
周りにスタッフもたくさんいたの。
すぐに誤解だって報道も出るはずだから。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
You can't trust tabloids.
They're filled with unfounded lies from cover to cover.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゴシップ記事なんて、
信じちゃダメだよ。
根も葉もない、
インチキばっかりなんだからね。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Like, if someone took a photo of you and me right now,
they'd write something like
\"Passionate romance with mystery man!\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
例えば今、
{0}くんと私が写真に撮られたら、
「一般人との熱愛発覚！」
とか書かれちゃうんだよ？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
N-no...?
Ahaha. Now I feel kinda embarrassed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そう……？
あはは、
なんか恥ずかしいな。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
...A problem, huh?
I get how you feel, but you don't have to be so harsh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふぅん、
困るんだ？
気持ちはわかるけど、
そんな強く否定しなくても……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, since we're just talking,
I don't think anyone will be taking our photo—
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ、
ただ話しているだけで、
そんな写真撮られることもないと思うけど──

text_block_list.name: Fan 1
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't that Nozomi?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なぁ、
あれって、
のぞみんじゃないか！？

text_block_list.name: Fan 2
text_block_list.text:
Wow! You're right!
I am a [i]huge[/i] fan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁ！　
ほんとだー！
私、
大ファンなんです～！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, shoot!
They've spotted us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
いけない！
気づかれちゃった！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what do we do?!
More and more people are gathering around!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ど、
どうしよう……！？
どんどん人が集まってきちゃう！？

text_block_list.name: Fan 1
text_block_list.text:
Hey, who's that next to her?
Doesn't look like he's her manager!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい、
隣にいるのって誰だ？
マネージャーって感じじゃないよな？

text_block_list.name: Fan 2
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's... her boyfriend!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかして……
恋人！？

text_block_list.name: Fan 1
text_block_list.text:
What!
Nozomi has a boyfriend?
I'm so envi... angry!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なに！？
のぞみんに恋人だとっ！
そんなのうらやま……
許せねぇ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
{0},
let's just get out of here!
Nothing we can say will help in this situation!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん、
とりあえず逃げよう！
こういう時は何を言っても無駄なの！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Here, let's go this way!
Take my hand!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
こっちからなら逃げられるよ！
私の手に掴まって！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
*huff, puff*...
I don't think they'll chase us all the way here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
はぁ……
ここまで来れば、
もう追ってこないよね。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry.
I was holding your hand the whole time and dragging you along with me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
ごめんね。
ずっと手つないだままで……
それに、
無理矢理引っ張ってきちゃって……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
But I didn't have a choice.
We had to get away from there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
仕方なかったのよ。
あそこは逃げるしかないもん。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
If they had turned that into a news story, 
I might not have been able to see you anymore...
I don't want that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのまま記事にでもされちゃったら、
もうキミと会えなくなるかもしれないし……
私、
そんなの嫌だよ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Shoot!
It's already time for my next appointment!
We didn't get to do anything fun...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ！　
いけない！
次の仕事の時間になっちゃった！
けっきょく全然遊べなかった～！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, {0}. I'll make it up to you next time! I promise!
So let's hang out again soon!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんね、{0}くん、また誘うから！　
絶対！
だから、また付き合ってね！

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Okay. Welcome back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
お疲れさま。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Think of what you just saw as a dream of sorts.
Chances are you'll forget everything the second you wake up,
so no need to brood over it too much.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたが今、
見てたのは夢みたいなものよ。
目覚めたらすぐに忘れちゃうと思うし、
今はあんまり気にしなくてもいいわ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
That said, Nozomi has it tough...
When you're that popular, you can't even walk around normally.
text_block_list.orig_text:
にしてもノゾミも大変ね……
人気者だと、
普通に外を歩くこともできないんだから。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Over \"there\" and of course, over \"here\"...
Nozomi is everyone's idol,
so you'd best be careful.
text_block_list.orig_text:
『あっち』ではもちろん『こっち』でも、
ノゾミはみんなのアイドルなわけだし、
あんたも気をつけたほうがいいわね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Pay special care not to do anything that gets in the way
of Nozomi's idol activities.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたが変なことをして、
ノゾミのアイドル活動を邪魔しないように、
しっかり注意しなさいよ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, that's enough for today.
Catch you later. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
今回はこのくらいで失礼するわ。
じゃあね～♪

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
*yawn*
Huh? Where am I?
Did I fall asleep?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぁ～……
あれ？　
ここは……？
私、
寝ちゃってたの？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
I had a weird dream...
Wonder what that was all about.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだか変な夢も見たし……
なんだったんだろう？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
We were together,
and my fans mistook you for my boyfriend.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんと一緒にいたら、
ファンの人たちに恋人と勘違いされちゃって……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
What? You had the same dream?
Wow, how strange.
Maybe it was a special dream. Like a prophecy or—
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
キミも同じ夢見てたの？
へぇ、
不思議だね。
なにか特別な夢だったりして。
例えば、
正夢とか──

text_block_list.name: Passerby 1
text_block_list.text: Ah! It's Nozomin!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
ノゾミンだ！

text_block_list.name: Passerby 2
text_block_list.text:
Hey! There's a dude next to her!
Don't tell me that's her boyfriend!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい、
隣に男がいるぞ！？
もしかして恋人か！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
Th-the dream really did come true!
{0}, let's run!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ！？
ほ、
本当に正夢になっちゃった！？
{0}くん、逃げよー！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The two locked hands and frantically ran away.
text_block_list.orig_text: 手を取り合って、慌てて逃げ出す二人であった。
